page.overview:
Who is Lor Botho?

Lor Botho was a miner who worked for Red Mine as a leader in the village of Charbana on the planet Mikkia. They mined akassia, which made earthquakes that destroyed Charbana. After the leader of the village died her daughter Gria Cappo blamed the mining company for the earthquakes and demanded an account of this from Lor Botho, when Jedi Master Mirro Lox and his Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo arrived in the village. Lor tried to kill them with poison gas, but the Jedi managed to prevent this. He and his miners were finally arrested.
